properties.name: The site says what reflow2 is and is not, in plain words, along the human decision process, with one design followed start to finish
properties.rationale:
Anthony, 2026-10-12: he struggles to explain what reflow2 is, and people hear "AI that replaces people". He accepted the recommendation to tell it as a partnership in plain words, along the human decision process, with one design shown before any hub ("Go with your recommendation on ..."), then "Let's write the pages next". This realizes req:the-site-says-what-reflow2-is-and-is-not-as-a-partnership-in-plain-words and its two children, through cap:the-site-explains-reflow2-in-three-pages-plain-first.

Every behaviour the pages describe was checked against reflow2 at v0.83.3. "reflow2 runs no AI" was measured: no crate depends on a model library, and the core's LlmBackend seam hands prompts to the caller's own agent. Three first-draft phrasings were corrected before commit: "measured or assumed" became "measured or a forecast" (the finding's basis); "point at a line" became "point at a file" (links are per file); and a gear-ratio change in step 6 that contradicted step 7 was replaced.

The capability stays in_progress until Anthony has read the pages: whether a non-technical reader understands them is his to judge. Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_019Xbw6PG9mXJiU2Sb421fnq
properties.subject: system
properties.summary:
Three pages:
- **site/index.html, rewritten.** It opens on the partnership: "You decide. The AI helps. reflow2 remembers why." It has an "is / isn't" pair and says plainly that reflow2 runs no AI, doesn't replace people or their conversations, and isn't needed for one-afternoon jobs. It has the three partners, each with what it brings and can't be trusted with, and the five decision steps in everyday words, each with what goes wrong and what reflow2 does about it. Then come what the record keeps, a pointer to the walkthrough, and the hub as the next step. It no longer calls one design a "project brain"; that phrase now names only a hub.
- **site/walkthrough.html, new.** The made-up Gearheads' climber in eight steps, from its first requirement into the code and back, each labelled with who does it.
- **site/why.html, new.** Each mistake people and AI make beside what catches it, fast and slow thinking as a comparison, and what reflow2 can't do.

Supporting changes:
- **site/draw.js, new:** the drawing helpers both explainer pages share.
- **site/style.css:** cards, the partners' colour chips, steps, table and paired lists.
- **tools/check_doc_versions.py and its test:** the version gate reads both new pages' "Checked against" line (16 claims).

Rendered with Playwright at 1280 and 390 px wide: no script errors, every drawing filled, no sideways scroll on a phone.
